factor_diagnostics.value_notes: Langan et al. (2024) modeled sockeye marine preferred SST at 1.0-11.5 °C (80% HDI), core 2.2-7.6 °C, median 6.1 °C and modal 5.0 °C, the coldest of the six salmon species analyzed. A separate juvenile Bering Sea study found strongest positive density effects around 11 °C and a threshold near 12 °C, illustrating life-stage differences. The configured 6-14 °C range and 8-12 °C ideal are shifted warm and miss much of the modeled marine preference; do not treat the juvenile study as an adult catch curve.
